params.message:
Make the 3D network fast with every relation drawn

With every relation in the graph, 3D drew about 2,400 separate objects
(a sphere per dot, a tube per line) and turning it stuttered; hovering
also rebuilt every name label. Now the library draws only the dots that
matter, opened projects and the lines of the dot in focus, as plain
lines; the small relations are one point cloud and the resting lines one
set of segments, each a single draw that moves with the simulation. That
brings a frame from ~2,400 draws to ~130. Hovering only recolours.

For both views: whether a dot is lit is looked up in a neighbour index
instead of walking every line for every dot each frame; the graph data
is kept out of Alpine's reactivity so the simulation's moves are not
tracked; the layout settles in fewer ticks, 3D starting from the flat
picture's places; and the 3D code is fetched while the page is idle.
three is now a direct dependency, at the version 3d-force-graph uses.
